gaps.name: Dog Stream Waterfall

gaps.name: Mount Isobel
gaps.reason: The peak above the village, with hiking tracks named by a guide and Wikipedia.

gaps.name: Queen Mary Hospital (Hanmer Springs)
gaps.reason: Has a Wikipedia article, Category I heritage buildings and a guide lists it as an attraction behind the pools.

gaps.name: Lewis Pass
gaps.reason: Wikipedia: scenic reserve with Alpine Nature Walk; 33 km from Hanmer, outside its span, no other destination -> standalone.

gaps.name: Hanmer Forest Park
gaps.reason: Named by DOC but it is a large area with no single entrance coordinate I could source; its tracks are covered by Dog Stream Waterfall and Conical Hill. Could be revisited with a sourced trailhead.

gaps.name: Hanmer Springs Animal Park
gaps.reason: Only an OSM entry found; no guide/Wikivoyage/DOC source naming it as somewhere to go.

gaps.name: Dog Stream Reserve / Woodland Walk / Majuba Walk
gaps.reason: Short local forest walks within the town; no coordinates sourced and not a distinct stop beyond Conical Hill.

gaps.name: Thomas Hanmer Memorial / Jollies Pass Hotel memorial / Jacks Pass viewpoint
gaps.reason: OSM-only minor features, no guide source.

gaps.name: Mouse Point Siphon
gaps.reason: OSM attraction ~20 km south, rarely visited, no guide source.

gaps.name: Lake Tennyson
gaps.reason: About 40+ km away on a 4WD high-country road, not reached from Hanmer as a day stop; no guide source found.

gaps.name: Maruia Springs
gaps.reason: West Coast side of Lewis Pass (~40 km), a commercial resort; not verified further.

new_spots.name: Dog Stream Waterfall
new_spots.bio: A 41-metre waterfall reached by the Waterfall Track through mountain beech forest in Hanmer Forest Park, with the steeper Spur Track as a loop option.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: Loaded the DOC page; title 'Waterfall Track: Hanmer Forest Park', text names the Dog Stream waterfall. Title is the track/park, not the fall by name, so reviewer may prefer null.
new_spots.photo_note: No Commons photo of this waterfall found in searches; set null.

new_spots.name: Mount Isobel
new_spots.bio: The 1,324 m peak that looks over Hanmer Springs, climbed on long tracks from Jacks Pass, Jollies Pass or Clarence Valley Road.
new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: No single official page; left null.
sources: https://hanmersprings.co.nz (Hanmer trails map, via search snippet: Jacks Pass/Jollies Pass/Clarence Valley Rd access; times unverified, I could not load the PDF)
new_spots.note: Wikipedia article title 'Mount Isobel' does not resolve via API (no article found); name only. Photo is 2008, 1024 px wide, mountain with village roofs and a patio umbrella in the foreground; marginal.

new_spots.name: Queen Mary Hospital
new_spots.bio: A former soldiers' hospital opened in 1916 beside the thermal pools, whose Soldiers' Block, Nurses' Home and Chisholm Block are Category I heritage buildings now owned by DOC.
new_spots.hours: Exterior viewable from the thermal reserve
new_spots.note: Visiting hours and access are unverified; photo shows a building (the attraction itself), dated 2019, colour.

new_spots.name: Lewis Pass
new_spots.coordinates_source: Wikipedia 'Lewis Pass' coordinates (saddle); standalone, ~33 km WNW of Hanmer Springs
new_spots.bio: A 907 m pass on State Highway 7 through native beech forest in a national scenic reserve, with a short Alpine Nature Walk loop around a tarn near the saddle.
